race_barbarians.name: Barbarians
race_barbarians.temper: Loud, proud and fearless; they respect strength first and honesty second, and test both with a fist.

race_daemons.name: Daemons
race_daemons.temper: Spawn of the burning Portal; every bargain with a daemon is honoured exactly — and costs more than it seemed.

race_dark_dwarves.name: Dark Dwarves
race_dark_dwarves.temper: Soot-black smiths of fire and iron; they trade fairly, build cruelly, and think every other folk a fuel.

race_dark_elves.name: Dark Elves
race_dark_elves.temper: Elegant, cruel and clever; the Dark Elves smile at every guest and count the cost of each smile.

race_dwarves.name: Dwarves
race_dwarves.temper: Stubborn, honest and slow to trust; a dwarf remembers a debt — and a grudge — for three generations.

race_empire.name: Empire
race_empire.temper: Practical, loud and loyal to the Lion Throne; they pay for help in bread, steel and favours.

race_fey.name: Fey
race_fey.temper: Merry, fickle and older than they look; a promise to the Fey is kept to the letter, never to the spirit.

race_high_elves.name: High Elves
race_high_elves.temper: Proud, patient and old; they measure time in moons and trust short-lived folk only after a deed.

race_knights.name: Knights
race_knights.temper: Sworn to chivalry and to the Shrine of the Sword; a stranger is judged by their deeds, never by their purse.

race_minotaurs.name: Minotaurs
race_minotaurs.temper: Proud bull-folk of the arena; they honour a fair fight above gold, and an unfair one is never forgiven.

race_orcs.name: Orcs
race_orcs.temper: Rough, greedy and honest about it; an orc sells you anything, including the truth, if the price is right.

race_plaguelords.name: Plaguelords
race_plaguelords.temper: Worshippers of rot and change; to the Plaguelords every living thing is a cure that has not yet spoiled.

race_ssrathi.name: Ssrathi
race_ssrathi.temper: Cold-blooded and patient lizard-folk of the jungle; they keep every bargain — and every slight — in the temple records.

race_swarm.name: Swarm
race_swarm.temper: One mind in a thousand shells; the Swarm trades with outsiders only until it learns how to eat them.

race_undead.name: Undead
race_undead.temper: The restless dead; they hold no grudge and feel no mercy, and every living guest is one they have not met yet.

race_wood_elves.name: Wood Elves
race_wood_elves.temper: Quiet hunters of the deep forest; they forgive a stranger once, and remember forever.

wall.name: Stockade
wall.text: A stockade of whole pine trunks; the Gate Warden lifts the bar only for friends of the clan.

wall.name: Brimstone Wall
wall.text: A wall of black brimstone that never cools; the Gate Daemon opens it only to friends of the pit.

wall.name: Iron Bulwark
wall.text: A bulwark of riveted iron plates; the Gate Golem opens it only to friends of the forge.

wall.name: Thorn Wall
wall.text: A wall of black thorn and silk; the Gate Blackguard lets in only friends of the spire.

wall.name: Stone Rampart
wall.text: A rampart of fitted granite; the Gate Warden opens it only to friends of the hold.

wall.name: Palisade
wall.text: A palisade of sharpened stakes: no way in but the gate, and the Gate Sergeant opens it only to friends of the village.

wall.name: Glamour Wall
wall.text: A wall of thorn and glamour; the Gate Oakman lets in only friends of the village — the rest walk in circles.

wall.name: Moonwall
wall.text: The moonwall of white stone: no way in but its one gate, and the Gatekeeper opens it only to friends of the village.

wall.name: Curtain Wall
wall.text: A curtain wall of dressed stone; the Gate Knight lowers the bridge only for friends of the village.

wall.name: Bronze Maze Wall
wall.text: The outer maze wall of bronze-bound stone; the Gate Bull opens it only to friends of the herd.

wall.name: Spiked Palisade
wall.text: A palisade of sharpened logs and old skulls; the Gate Grunt lets in only friends of the camp.

wall.name: Bone Wall
wall.text: A wall of fused bone and black slime; the Gate Ghoul lets in only friends of the plague.

wall.name: Serpent Wall
wall.text: A wall of carved serpent stones; the Gate Snake lets in only friends of the temple.

wall.name: Resin Wall
wall.text: A wall of hardened resin and sand; the Gate Scorpion lets in only friends of the hive.

wall.name: Gravestone Wall
wall.text: A wall of old gravestones; the Gate Knight lets in only friends of the dead.

wall.name: Living Hedge
wall.text: A hedge of living thornwood grown wall-thick; the Gate Warden parts it only for friends of the village.

data.innate_effect_text: Awe (Air, Harmony): target cannot deal damage to you until they visit their tower.

logic.description: Angel of Mercy (caster) — stats V17/W20/M16/Wi16, Σ 69, life 7 = round(Σ/10). World (Souls, Time, Space) is its highest stat (20), so under Rule 21 casts of those elements lose most of their delta against it (max(caster − 20, 0) per element, Σ/10 rounded half up); Matter (Air, Water, Earth, Fire) is weakest (16) and hurts it most. A Summoning / Resurrect must bank 69 stat points to take it (stat_buy_paid). 1 action(s) per round. dice_pattern null = default BMAP 4d6 (Rule 5: one green Block, one blue/white Move, one red Attack, one black Posture die; the highest face is the action; the engine deals it an 11-card 6A/3M/1P/1B action deck in that spirit). When Posture wins it may pick an effect from its hand and skips the dice until every element is emitted. Innate effect effect_awe (elem_air + elem_harmony; permanent): "The target cannot deal damage to you until they visit their tower." It sits in the monster's hand once awakened and is cast on Posture / Empty Posture (Rule 20); it can only go out while none of its elements is Disabled. No on-action rider: damage is the plain resolution-matrix edge (rps_edge). Rule 3: once awakened it defends its tile, never leaves it, attacks any character in contact, regenerates to full when no enemy is in contact, and the next enemy player (after the one in contact) controls it. If a Summoning (∀ bind) or Resurrect takes it, it becomes the owner's ally (its alliance flips to the owner's side), follows the owner (closes the gap, fights only what is in reach) and when the permanent that holds it falls it vanishes (companion), falls again (raised) or returns to its own side (bound). Deck effects (user rulings 2026-11-15, rule_monster_deck_effects): its deck holds the 4 thematic effect cards Turn life (effect_turn_life), Ice blast (effect_ice_blast), Shield (effect_shield), Potion brew (effect_potion_brew) (data.deck_effects, picked by game/monster-deck.mjs pickThematicEffects: AI-castable, affordable for its stats under monster_effect_affordable, 2 damage + 1 defensive + the best remaining, scored by stats, tags, name and innate effect) plus data.monster_deck.random random playable effects fixed per monster instance (seed: map seed, peer label, creature id) — 11 actions + 4 skills + 6 effects = 21 cards. Once awake npcPlan casts the affordable ones on Posture / Empty Posture (game/monster-deck.mjs npcCastChoice: damage on an enemy in reach, defence with an enemy within 2, control on an enemy in contact), continues a cast without moving (Rule 19) and recycles an unusable effect card to its discard pile when no action card is left in hand. Summons keep the 15-card deck.

prerequisites.description: Rule 2/3: the creature acts only after its tile was attacked or moved towards (awakened).
Rule 3: it attacks only a character in contact (hex distance ≤ 1) — it never leaves its tile to chase.
effect_awe may go out: only Posture / Empty Posture emit elements (Rule 20) and none of its elements is Disabled for the monster.

effects.description: Life = round_half_up(Σstats / 10) from the canonical stats.
What a Summoning / Resurrect must bank to take this creature: its stat sum.
Actions the monster plays each round (Rule 1).
D6 thrown per action: the pattern length, or 4 for the default BMAP set (Rule 5).
Number of Attack (red) faces among the dice thrown (default BMAP); a literal because JsonLogic cannot count letters in a string.
Number of Block (green) faces among the dice thrown (default BMAP); a literal because JsonLogic cannot count letters in a string.
Number of Move (blue/white) faces among the dice thrown (default BMAP); a literal because JsonLogic cannot count letters in a string.
Number of Posture (black) faces among the dice thrown (default BMAP); a literal because JsonLogic cannot count letters in a string.
No on-action rider — always 0.
Resolution-matrix damage of the monster's revealed action against the defender's (1 for Attack, +1 on a winning edge, Attack vs Posture = 2).
Rule 21: damage a completed cast by `caster` with `elements` does to this creature with its canonical stats (its high stat shrugs those elements off).
Rule 3: with no enemy in contact the monster regenerates to full — life restored this turn; 0 while engaged.
Effect cards in a monster deck of this creature: its deck_effects plus the random ones (rule_monster_deck_effects data.monster_deck.random).

validation.description: Each of the four stats may move at most ±5 from the canonical value.
life equals round_half_up(Σ proposal stats / 10).
actions_per_round stays 1..4 and is not changed by a rebalance.
dice_pattern is null (default BMAP) or 3–6 face letters out of A B M P.
innate_effect is null or the id of an existing effect (catalog lookup of its element_cost).
on_action_rider is null or { action ∈ action codes, bonus_damage 1..3 }.
deck_effects is absent or exactly data.monster_deck.thematic distinct effect ids (monster_deck_effects_valid).
Every deck effect exists and is affordable for the proposal stats (monster_effect_affordable over the stat behind each element; delta = a damage effect without point_buy).

logic.description: Bant Battlemage 3P (caster) — stats V12/W20/M16/Wi16, Σ 64, life 5 on the card although round(Σ/10) = 6 (data contradiction, see validation life_matches_proposal_stats). World (Souls, Time, Space) is its highest stat (20), so under Rule 21 casts of those elements lose most of their delta against it (max(caster − 20, 0) per element, Σ/10 rounded half up); Vitality (elem_vitality) is weakest (12) and hurts it most. A Summoning / Resurrect must bank 64 stat points to take it (stat_buy_paid). 1 action(s) per round. dice_pattern null = default BMAP 4d6 (Rule 5: one green Block, one blue/white Move, one red Attack, one black Posture die; the highest face is the action; the engine deals it an 11-card 6A/3M/1P/1B action deck in that spirit). When Posture wins it may pick an effect from its hand and skips the dice until every element is emitted. Innate effect effect_love (elem_water + elem_harmony; permanent): "The target cannot deal damage to you until they visit their tower." It sits in the monster's hand once awakened and is cast on Posture / Empty Posture (Rule 20); it can only go out while none of its elements is Disabled. No on-action rider: damage is the plain resolution-matrix edge (rps_edge). Rule 3: once awakened it defends its tile, never leaves it, attacks any character in contact, regenerates to full when no enemy is in contact, and the next enemy player (after the one in contact) controls it. If a Summoning (∀ bind) or Resurrect takes it, it becomes the owner's ally (its alliance flips to the owner's side), follows the owner (closes the gap, fights only what is in reach) and when the permanent that holds it falls it vanishes (companion), falls again (raised) or returns to its own side (bound). Deck effects (user rulings 2026-11-15, rule_monster_deck_effects): its deck holds the 4 thematic effect cards Lightning (effect_lightning), Space-bending (effect_space_bending), The Void (effect_the_void), Combustion (effect_combustion) (data.deck_effects, picked by game/monster-deck.mjs pickThematicEffects: AI-castable, affordable for its stats under monster_effect_affordable, 2 damage + 1 defensive + the best remaining, scored by stats, tags, name and innate effect) plus data.monster_deck.random random playable effects fixed per monster instance (seed: map seed, peer label, creature id) — 11 actions + 4 skills + 6 effects = 21 cards. Once awake npcPlan casts the affordable ones on Posture / Empty Posture (game/monster-deck.mjs npcCastChoice: damage on an enemy in reach, defence with an enemy within 2, control on an enemy in contact), continues a cast without moving (Rule 19) and recycles an unusable effect card to its discard pile when no action card is left in hand. Summons keep the 15-card deck.

prerequisites.description: Rule 2/3: the creature acts only after its tile was attacked or moved towards (awakened).
Rule 3: it attacks only a character in contact (hex distance ≤ 1) — it never leaves its tile to chase.
effect_love may go out: only Posture / Empty Posture emit elements (Rule 20) and none of its elements is Disabled for the monster.

D6 thrown per action: the pattern length, or 4 for the default BMAP set (Rule 5).

Number of Block (green) faces among the dice thrown (default BMAP); a literal because JsonLogic cannot count letters in a string.

No on-action rider — always 0.

Rule 21: damage a completed cast by `caster` with `elements` does to this creature with its canonical stats (its high stat shrugs those elements off).

Will (Concentration, Harmony) is its highest stat (20), so under Rule 21 casts of those elements lose most of their delta against it (max(caster − 20, 0) per element, Σ/10 rounded half up); World (Souls, Time, Space) is weakest (10) and hurts it most. A Summoning / Resurrect must bank 55 stat points to take it (stat_buy_paid). 2 action(s) per round. dice_pattern null = default BMAP 4d6 (Rule 5: one green Block, one blue/white Move, one red Attack, one black Posture die; the highest face is the action; the engine deals it an 11-card 6A/3M/1P/1B action deck in that spirit). When Posture wins it may pick an effect from its hand and skips the dice until every element is emitted. Innate effect effect_fear (elem_air + elem_harmony; permanent): "The target character cannot do any damage until reaching their tower." It sits in the monster's hand once awakened and is cast on Posture / Empty Posture (Rule 20); it can only go out while none of its elements is Disabled. No on-action rider: damage is the plain resolution-matrix edge (rps_edge). Rule 3: once awakened it defends its tile, never leaves it, attacks any character in contact, regenerates to full when no enemy is in contact, and the next enemy player (after the one in contact) controls it. If a Summoning (∀ bind) or Resurrect takes it, it becomes the owner's ally (its alliance flips to the owner's side), follows the owner (closes the gap, fights only what is in reach) and when the permanent that holds it falls it vanishes (companion), falls again (raised) or returns to its own side (bound). Deck effects (user rulings 2026-11-15, rule_monster_deck_effects): its deck holds the 4 thematic effect cards Drain (effect_drain), Ice blast (effect_ice_blast), Disable (effect_disable), Combustion (effect_combustion) (data.deck_effects, picked by game/monster-deck.mjs pickThematicEffects: AI-castable, affordable for its stats under monster_effect_affordable, 2 damage + 1 defensive + the best remaining, scored by stats, tags, name and innate effect) plus data.monster_deck.random random playable effects fixed per monster instance (seed: map seed, peer label, creature id) — 11 actions + 4 skills + 6 effects = 21 cards. Once awake npcPlan casts the affordable ones on Posture / Empty Posture (game/monster-deck.mjs npcCastChoice: damage on an enemy in reach, defence with an enemy within 2, control on an enemy in contact), continues a cast without moving (Rule 19) and recycles an unusable effect card to its discard pile when no action card is left in hand. Summons keep the 15-card deck.
